notes.title: Improved internationalization support!
notes.notes:
Dear Wild Radio Fluxers,

in the past few days, we were working on another update for Wild Radio Flux game. We are improving the internationalization support, in particular for the simplified Chinese language.
We finally fixed a very tedious bug that didn't allow the game to properly show Chinese language in the right way for users.
We really apologize to all Chinese friends who were interested in playing Wild Radio Flux.
In addition, a couple of other variable bugs related to the translation system are now fixed, and translation should work properly.

Further, we decided to make the game a bit easier to play due to some requests. Defeating enemies is now easier because we have reduced their power and energy.

notes.title: How to play
notes.notes:
Welcome everyone :)

Just some simple tricks about how to play Wild Radio Flux

[b]CONTROLLER[/b] - The game can be played via keyboard or controller and it's been properly tested by Steam testers as always.
[b]LOAD/SAVE[/b] - You have 6 slots to save or load the game anytime. Just press ESC button (or X on XBox controller) to open the menu and pause the game.
[b]HELPBOOK[/b] - You also have options and a help book to learn how to play and what to do.
[b]INTRO[/b] - The introduction/story can be skipped with ESC button.
[b]SPEED/ACTION[/b] - Wild Radio Flux is based on RPG mechanics, so you have to play more to grow your character and improve your abilities.

[b]MOVING[/b] - Just use keyboard or analog or digital controller.
[b]SLIDE FAST[/b] - Press twice fast left or right key on your keyboard or use the analog or digital of your controller to slide left or right faster, to overpass enemies and dangerous obstacles.
[b]DOUBLE JUMP[/b] - Simply pres jump key twice (SHIFT key or B button of your controller)
[b]MENU[/b] - You can call the menu and pose the game anytime just pressing ESC key or X button of your XBox controller or CROSS for Playstation controller.

SPECIALS:
[b]POWER ATTACK[/b] - Press down button + 3times attack for the power attack. This attack costs 5 gold coins and its based on your character level * weapon * 3
[b]MUSIC BOOK[/b] - Collecting iconic music and cultural relics is imortant in WRF. To open your collections but also to see your character achievements just press TAB or the RB of your controller, then navigate using LEFT/RIGHT

 Please don't hesitate to contact us for more info.

Best

notes.title: Final Game Update!
notes.notes:
A GREAT IMMENSE THANKS to every person behind this project! We are so glad to tell you that Wild Radio Flux has been uploaded on Steam (and we are now waiting their test ːsteamthumbsupː )

After the Stem fest in October, many enthusiast players told us some major aspect that could significantly improve the game. And of course, working hard... we did it.

Well, I think the bullet list below can gives you more about what to find out in Wild Radio Flux game after this major update:


[list]
[*] [b]Wider View[/b]: that's been requested by several players and testers too. We zoomed out the game camera to 50%, so now the entire game view around your hero character can offers you more space to understand where to do.
[*] 
[*] [b]Power Attack[/b]: each hero character you select can activate a special attack in 3 directions. This attack is also more powerful than the standard attack and it causes from 2 to 4 time damages than the standard attack, multiply for the weapon and character class.
[*] 
[*] [b]More Gold Coins and Hidden Treasures[/b]: in Wild Radio Flux is crucial to have gold coins to spend for food and partially restore energy but especially to activate the Power Attack. That's why you placed more coins, hidden treasures and secret areas.
[*] 
[*] [b]New Soundtracks[/b]: yes at K Storm Studio we also have a dedicated section to produce music for our games and for Wild Radio Flux we created some soundtrack with a retro vibes!
[*] 
[*] [b]Dangerous Giant Machinery[/b]: that was already under development. We added dangerous giants machinery along the levels as a part of them.
[*] 
[*] [b]More New Bosses[/b]: we were already working about more bosses even along the levels to keep gameplay fresh.
[*] 
[*] [b]Redesigned UI[/b]: part of the game UI has been completely redesigned in a more modern way.
[*] 
[*] [b]Improved Backgrounds[/b]: we added more parallaxes (up to 30 in some cases) for both background and foreground, giving more dynamic to the player movement and a improving the graphical impact.
[/list]

... and now just under Steam test, then...  Wild Radio Flux!

What the Hell, yeah... One of the major sides in developing Wild Radio Flux has been making the code as flexible as possible. F... saying, that's been very hard, but wow guys! This means having a game based on seasons, moddable, and expandable with new characters and soundtracks.

But this aspect of the source code required to develop every part of the game simultaneously (I hope it's worth it!!!).

Now we can finally dedicate more attention to one of our favorite sides of this game: appearance.
And so we could finally change the character's weapons (yeah I know... the previous idea was nice, but we prefer to have something less funny and more cool). As well as riching every single stage with more graphical assets, characters, enemies, and more.

Hope you may like it... hey, come to play with us at the Steam Fest ok?
Guys we always try to inject all our passion into our games!! Hope you can enjoy...
Love youuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!!!!!!!!

notes.title: Wild Radio Flux introducing the melee combat!
notes.notes:
Just like the traditional Metroidvania game, we've seen that it was important for our characters to fight in a different way based on their distance from the enemy.
So now our characters switch from melee combat to their specific weapons automatically.

Despite Wild Radio Flux has even another mood compared to the classic Metroidvania, this new feature improves the gameplay and also it emphasizes the game style: a Back to the 80's!
